title: fix(local): normalize astra effort to xhigh and record effective effort
body:
### Motivation
- Address #237 after both astra endpoints reported `medium` for legacy `ultra`
  requests while honouring `xhigh`; sol continues to honour `ultra` as `max`.

### Description
- Resolve effort after account/model selection, mapping astra's omitted or
  legacy `ultra` request to `xhigh` while preserving other explicit astra
  efforts and all sol behavior.
- Validate math-fix dispatches against effective astra `xhigh` and record the
  effective CLI request as optional `requested_effort`, distinct from measured
  provider effort and backward-compatible with historical rows.
- Synchronize the session, math-fix, review, telemetry, and model-comparison
  documentation with the recorded incident and owner decision.

### Testing
- `bash -n local/bin/dispatch.sh local/bin/review.sh`
- `python3 -m py_compile local/bin/telemetry.py scripts/tests/test_dispatch.py`
- `python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_dispatch` (31 tests)
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py'` (537 tests)
- Normal pre-commit hooks passed while creating `954c1bc`.
- No Lean build was run because no Lean, blueprint, toolchain, or Lake input
  changed.

---
Closes #237
